title: Backup transcription factor binding sites protect human genes from mutations in the promoter
one_liner_zh: 该文通过统计人类脑/肝特异基因启动子中TFBS丰度与表达水平的关系，提出备份TFBS抗突变假说，但仅基于序列统计，无AI或物理模拟方法，也未涉及三维互作建模。
abstract: This study was designed to test the idea that human gene promoters have evolved to be resistant to the effects of mutations in their primary function, the control of gene expression. It is proposed that the transcription factor/transcription factor binding site (TF/TFBS) pair having the greatest effect on control of a gene is the one with the highest abundance in the promoter. Other pairs would have the same effect on gene expression and would predominate in the event of a mutation in the most abundant pair. It is expected that the overall promoter architecture proposed here will be highly resistant to mutagenic change that would otherwise affect expression of the gene. The idea was tested beginning with a database of 42 human genes highly specific for expression in brain. For each gene, information was accumulated about its expression level and about the TFBS occupancy of the five most abundant TF/TFBS pairs. Expression level was then plotted against TFBS occupancy separately for each of the five pairs, and the plots were compared with each other. The plots were found to be similar, and the results were interpreted to indicate that the TFBS occupancy ranks evolved to yield the same effect on gene expression level with multiple ranks able to function in the event of mutation in another. A similar analysis was conducted with a database of 31 human liver specific genes, and the overall result was found to be the same. Backup TFBS occupancy ranks were interpreted to be present in both brain and liver specific genes. Finally, the TFBSs in the brain specific and liver specific gene populations were compared with each other with the goal of identifying any brain selective or liver selective TFBSs. Of the 89 TFBSs in the pooled population, 58 were found only in brain specific but not liver specific genes, 8 only in liver specific but not brain specific genes and 23 were found in both brain and liver specific genes. The results were interpreted to emphasize the large number of TFBS in brain specific but not liver specific genes.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在检验人类基因启动子在其主要功能——基因表达调控方面，是否已进化出对突变效应的抵抗性。提出假设认为，对基因调控影响最大的转录因子/转录因子结合位点（TF/TFBS）对，是启动子中丰度最高的那一对。其他配对在基因表达上具有相同效应，并在最丰富配对发生突变时占据主导地位。预期此处提出的整体启动子架构将对可能影响基因表达的突变变化具有高度抵抗性。该假设从包含42个高度脑特异性表达的人类基因数据库开始进行检验。对每个基因，收集了其表达水平及五个最丰富TF/TFBS对的TFBS占据信息。随后，分别针对这五个配对，将表达水平与TFBS占据率作图，并相互比较这些图。发现这些图相似，结果被解读为表明TFBS占据率排名进化出对基因表达水平的相同效应，且多个排名能在另一排名发生突变时发挥作用。对包含31个人类肝脏特异性基因的数据库进行了类似分析，发现总体结果相同。备份TFBS占据率排名被解读为存在于脑特异性和肝脏特异性基因中。最后，将脑特异性和肝脏特异性基因群体中的TFBS相互比较，旨在识别任何脑选择性或肝脏选择性TFBS。在合并群体中的89个TFBS中，58个仅存在于脑特异性而非肝脏特异性基因中，8个仅存在于肝脏特异性而非脑特异性基因中，23个同时存在于脑特异性和肝脏特异性基因中。结果被解读为强调脑特异性而非肝脏特异性基因中TFBS数量众多。
